title: Zoning text change for 132 Melrose Street, Brooklyn
summary: This application establishes a Mandatory Inclusionary Housing Area at 132-136 Melrose Street in Bushwick, Brooklyn, pairing with a related zoning map change. Together the actions would enable a six-story mixed-use building with 18 apartments, five permanently income-restricted, and 6,000 square feet of ground-floor commercial space.
